recipes.claim: The member-reachable app-token exchange is DEPLOYED on api.barkpark.cloud: POST /v1/barkparks/b2b81e69-…/app-token returns 200 with a bpapp_ token, permissions [read,write,chat], expires_at null, workspace_id 03e3d6d9-d123-4557-9c06-ae4382a20626.

The minted token is member-shaped at the wire: GET guerrilla /v1/structure/production -> 403 forbidden 'token lacks required permission' (the smoke.sh admin-floor oracle bounces), while member-legal reads succeed — /api/schemas 200, /v1/tasks?limit=1 200, /v1/tasks/prime?view=brief 200, /v1/capabilities reports auth_tier 'write' (never 'admin').
recipes.rerun: TOK=<minted>; for U in v1/structure/production api/schemas 'v1/tasks?limit=1' v1/capabilities; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$U %{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" "https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/$U"; done

recipes.claim: BP_SMOKE_REQUIRE_EXCHANGE=1 bash tooling/mobile-smoke/smoke.sh passes 12 ok / 0 failed in mode=exchange against LIVE guerrilla today (2026-07-26) — mint, capabilities, structure-403 oracle, tasks prime, tasks events, SSE welcome, paper read, chat sessions 200 (39 sessions), and the three ghost-id 404 oracles.

The revoke half is live and self-cleaning: DELETE /v1/barkparks/:id/app-token with an EMPTY body (logout-everywhere) returned 200 {"revoked_count":2}, after which the minted token 401s ('missing or invalid token') and /v1/capabilities drops to auth_tier 'none'. A second DELETE returns 200 {"revoked_count":0} — idempotent.

smoke.sh's fleet walk DIVERGES from the app: smoke.sh hits bare GET /v1/barkparks (team-scoped to current_team) while apps/mobile/src/cloud/api.ts:208 hits /v1/barkparks?scope=all and only sets X-Barkpark-Team when opts.teamId is given (api.ts:105). Live counts differ: scope=all -> 5 barkparks across 2 teams, bare -> 4. cloud/lib/barkpark_cloud/web/auth.ex:62-68 falls back to Accounts.primary_team(user) (OLDEST membership) when no x-barkpark-team header is sent, so smoke.sh only passes for a member whose OLDEST membership is the Guerrilla team; otherwise the fleet walk dies at 'no barkpark with url … in the cloud fleet'.
recipes.rerun: CT=…; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CT" 'https://api.barkpark.cloud/v1/barkparks?scope=all' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)["barkparks"]))'; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CT" https://api.barkpark.cloud/v1/barkparks | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)["barkparks"]))'; git show origin/main:cloud/lib/barkpark_cloud/web/auth.ex | sed -n '55,69p'

recipes.claim: The owner account holds TWO team memberships (Guerrilla owner 506f035e…, Gyldendal admin 9d71ba21…), and config.json's cloud_team equals the Guerrilla id, which is exactly what /v1/me reports as the active/primary team. Because login (cloud12_cmd.go:215, login_device.go:176, setup_cloud_login.go:105) writes resp.TeamID = the primary team and `bp team use` (teams_cmd.go:150) would write the same id here, the on-disk value is INDISTINGUISHABLE between the two writers — no `bp team use` is needed for the exchange, which sends no team pin and still resolves Guerrilla.
recipes.rerun: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CT" https://api.barkpark.cloud/v1/me | python3 -m json.tool | head -50; git grep -n 'CloudTeam =' -- internal/cli | grep -v _test
